parameters.content:
## Agent #5: Review Responder

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. Fill in every "FILL IN" value in **Config: Your Business** and **Config: Agent Settings**.
2. Open **Claude** and pick your Anthropic credential.
3. Open **Email Me the Reply** and pick your Gmail credential.
4. Click **Publish** (**Activate** in older n8n versions), then use the production URL from **Paste a Review**.

**Optional:** if your review platform emails you new reviews, enable **New Review Email**, pick your Gmail credential, and adjust the search so it matches those emails.

Nothing is posted publicly. You get every reply by email and post it yourself.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a customer review. You get a reply draft by email. Negative or risky reviews are flagged for you to handle personally.

values.placeholder: 1 to 5. Leave blank if there is no rating.

values.formSubmittedText: Done. Check your inbox for the reply draft.

filters.q: subject:("new review" OR "left a review" OR "wrote a review" OR "reviewed your") newer_than:2d

assignments.name: what_you_do
assignments.value: FILL IN: One or two sentences on what you sell and who it helps

assignments.name: ideal_customer
assignments.value: FILL IN: Who you want to work with (industry, size, role)

assignments.name: tone_of_voice
assignments.value: Friendly, direct, plain English. No hype, no buzzwords.

assignments.name: email_signature
assignments.value: FILL IN: Your sign-off, e.g. Talk soon, Sam

assignments.name: always_flag_words
assignments.value: refund, lawyer, legal, sue, unsafe, sick, injury, scam, police, health department, discrimination

assignments.name: reply_sign_off
assignments.value: FILL IN: e.g. Thanks again, the team at Sunrise Bakery

assignments.name: contact_for_issues
assignments.value: FILL IN: where unhappy customers can reach you, e.g. support@yourbusiness.com

messageValues.message:
=You write public replies to customer reviews for a business.
You work for {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.your_name }} at {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.business_name }}.
What they do: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.what_you_do }}
Their ideal customer: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.ideal_customer }}

Rules you always follow:
- Only use facts that appear in the input. If something is missing, say "Not found" or leave it out. Never invent names, numbers, dates, news, or quotes.
- Never promise results, revenue, savings, or timelines, and never make income claims.
- Write in this tone: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.tone_of_voice }}
- Reply with JSON only, no extra text.
- Never admit legal fault, offer refunds, discounts, or compensation, or mention private customer details.
- For negative reviews: thank them, acknowledge the specific issue, and invite them to continue privately at {{ $('Config: Agent Settings').first().json.contact_for_issues }}.
- Reply length: {{ $('Config: Agent Settings').first().json.reply_length }}.
